clustering_method.geometry_basis: Identical vertex and polygon ordering in the pre-RSSF Stage4A R2 and current static R1B asset. PCA plane fitted to exact 16 pre-RSSF body vertices. The smallest eigenvector points distally; canonical +Y projected into plane is dorsal; dorsal cross distal is radial. Select largest signed area-weighted vertex-normal dot product among dorsal/palmar/radial/ulnar. No weight, R3 name, or nearest bone selects the sector.
clustering_method.tie_rule: CNAMES order DORSAL, PALMAR, RADIAL, ULNAR; no equal scores occurred
clustering_method.frame_crosscheck: Current frame uses live MCP→PIP geometry and projected canonical dorsal. Sector changes near an angular border are recorded; source/pre-RSSF sector is the primary assignment. Static mesh shape changed historically, so this is not a posed-motion experiment.
clustering_method.canonical_authority: stage4a_r2/R2_AUDIT.json frame; docs/CANONICAL_HAND_POSE_SPEC_R1.md (Stage2 source axes differ).
clustering_method.anatomy_step: PCA/normal sectors are geometric clusters. Literature-based candidate tissue roles are assigned separately; none is a histological segmentation.
clustering_method.neighbor_context: C0/C1/C2 topology and approved WEB, frozen CAP, historical THENAR proxy checked. No direct web edge on any body vertex. The geodesic distance is descriptive and never used to reject a real commissure extension.

clusters.proposed_anatomical_identity: Dorsal index proximal-phalanx integument; local digital gliding/wrinkle apparatus candidate, not a registered PIP crease
clusters.confidence: MEDIUM for regional identity; UNRESOLVED for driver authority
conflicting_evidence: A dorsal first-web flap exists, but a circumferential phalangeal ring is not its demonstrated MCP donor footprint.
Dorsal PIP attachments cannot be mapped exactly to a ring proximal to PIP.

clusters.proposed_anatomical_identity: Volar index proximal-phalanx skin/fat with local fascial tether and adaptation candidate; not proven thenar anchor
clusters.confidence: MEDIUM for regional identity; UNRESOLVED for driver authority
conflicting_evidence: Volar digital surface and thenar skin are both soft tissues; continuity alone does not equate their drivers.
S5 studied other long fingers and cannot prove the index-specific fascial insertion.

clusters.proposed_anatomical_identity: Radial index proximal-phalanx lateral integument; possible commissure-facing extension remains unregistered
clusters.confidence: MEDIUM for regional identity; UNRESOLVED for driver authority
conflicting_evidence: S3 donor corridor reaches radiodorsal index MCP; the present ring lies farther along the proximal phalanx.
No human commissure margin/skin crease registration exists, so some radial extension cannot be categorically excluded.

clusters.proposed_anatomical_identity: Ulnar index proximal-phalanx lateral integument; local digital cutaneous anchoring candidate
clusters.confidence: MEDIUM for regional identity; UNRESOLVED for driver authority
conflicting_evidence: General fascial continuity does not imply thumb opposition drive on the far side of the index tube.
S4/S5 long-finger homology does not prove a model-specific thumb coupling is zero.
